name: ROS 2 Development Container (macOS)
postCreateCommand: . .devcontainer/setup.sh && sudo rosdep update --rosdistro=jazzy && sudo rosdep install --from-paths lib src --ignore-src -y --rosdistro=jazzy && for d in build install log lib; do [ -d /home/ros2_ws/$d ] && sudo chown -R $(whoami) /home/ros2_ws/$d; done && (rm -r build/ || true) && colcon build --symlink-install
